Message: Requests intermittently receive a gateway 503 although the service readiness check remains green.
The browser completes sign-in, then loops back to the login page after the session refresh redirect.
The order endpoint reports success, but the order row is missing after the transaction retries.
Clean Linux agents fail to package a generated file whose path differs only by letter casing.
The token works for the first page of results; the next page is rejected after the signing key rotates.
A burst of parallel calls receives 429 responses while the same requests pass when run individually.
The invoice worker marks its job complete, but a later read returns the previous committed total.
Compilation succeeds on developer machines, while hosted agents cannot resolve a generated source file.
